jobs.title: Senior Director, HR Operations (Strategy, Transformation & Enablement)
jobs.jobDescription: Executive role defining the long-term vision for global HR service delivery and an autonomous, AI-powered operating model. Owns multi-year strategy, roadmap, operating-model and governance evolution, global HR operational transformation, process redesign, system optimization, organizational redesign, AI/intelligent automation/self-service adoption, HRSD governance, agentic workflows, workforce capability transformation, and C-suite stakeholder alignment. Requires 12+ years in HR operations/shared services/service delivery, 5+ years global senior leadership, large-scale HR transformation, operating-model design, technology-enabled delivery, global team leadership and executive influence. ServiceNow HRSD, AI-augmented delivery, Workday and organizational upskilling are preferred.
jobs.fitLane: HR Transformation / Future of Work / AI-Enabled Service Delivery
jobs.summary: Exceptional strategic alignment across global HR transformation, AI-enabled delivery, operating-model design, governance and executive influence.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, HR Technology
jobs.location: San Jose, CA / U.S. geographic markets
jobs.jobDescription: Leads Adobe's multi-year HR technology strategy at the intersection of business priorities, people strategy and technology execution. Owns a connected intelligent ecosystem across HCM, talent and employee-experience platforms; advances AI-first HR technology; designs end-to-end employee experiences; shapes HR data and architecture strategy; modernizes and simplifies platforms and integrations; establishes governance and prioritization; serves as trusted advisor to senior HR and business leaders; and leads a global product, engineering, architecture and operations organization. Requires 12+ years in HR technology, enterprise systems or IT leadership and a record of large-scale enterprise platform transformation.
jobs.fitLane: HR Technology Strategy / Employee Experience / AI
jobs.summary: Excellent next-level HR technology strategy role with AI-first employee experience, enterprise modernization and executive influence.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Transformation - Virtual
jobs.jobDescription: Senior enterprise transformation leader responsible for integrated execution of the organization's most complex strategic priorities across business and technology. Translates enterprise strategy into executable transformation roadmaps, establishes operating model and governance, connects work to common priorities and measurable outcomes, and operates regularly with C-suite executives. Leads governance forums covering progress, risk, dependencies, tradeoffs, decisions and value realization. The posting explicitly states this is not traditional program management: the role operates above individual programs to connect strategy, integrated execution and enterprise outcomes. Requires 15+ years in enterprise/business/technology transformation, strategy execution or portfolio leadership, strong financial acumen, executive communication and structured problem solving. Preferred experience includes digital experience, technology modernization, data platforms, operating-model redesign and global transformation.
jobs.fitLane: Enterprise Strategy / Business Transformation / Executive Governance
jobs.summary: Standout broadening move beyond HRIS: true enterprise transformation, C-suite governance, operating-model work and $260K-$290K base.

jobs.title: Director, AI Transformation & Intelligent Business Enablement
jobs.jobDescription: Leads the enterprise approach to applied AI across Sun Chemical/DIC Group, translating AI capability into measurable business value across commercial, manufacturing and functional teams. Owns the enterprise AI transformation roadmap; builds a federated AI Center of Excellence and governance model; partners with business and HR leaders on workforce impacts, process redesign and future-state skills; drives AI literacy and adoption; builds ROI/value-realization frameworks; advises senior leadership and boards; and navigates a global matrix. Requires 10+ years in business/strategy transformation or technology leadership, 3+ years owning AI/ML or advanced analytics/platform programs, enterprise transformation experience, executive communication and global stakeholder leadership.
jobs.fitLane: AI Strategy / Enterprise Transformation / Workforce Capability
jobs.summary: Especially compelling because it combines AI strategy, transformation governance, workforce redesign and capability building in a global industrial environment.

jobs.title: Director, AI Platform & Transformation
jobs.jobDescription: Leads iRhythm's enterprise AI strategy across platform, technology, business transformation and adoption, moving AI from experimentation into secure, scalable, measurable production use. Defines the AI platform and transformation roadmap, prioritizes enterprise AI opportunities, leads initiatives through production and adoption, and partners across business, Data/Engineering, IT, Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Quality and Finance. The role includes generative AI, LLMs, RAG, agents, workflow orchestration, model evaluation and governed data products, combining executive leadership with technical depth.
jobs.fitLane: AI Strategy / Enterprise Transformation / Product Platform
jobs.summary: Strong compensation and enterprise AI scope; slightly more technical than the ideal lane but still a meaningful transformation opportunity.

jobs.title: Director, AI Strategy & Transformation
jobs.jobDescription: Director-level role responsible for AI strategy and transformation across ButterflyMX. Current public posting describes ownership of an AI transformation roadmap balancing near-term wins with longer-term strategic investments. The role is positioned around enterprise AI strategy, transformation, adoption and business value rather than tactical system support. Public listings show a U.S. full-time role with a $200,000-$300,000 salary range.
jobs.summary: Compelling AI-strategy pivot with strong compensation; worth assessment once the full employer posting is accessible.

jobs.title: Senior Director, HR Technology Products
jobs.jobDescription: Virtual senior director reporting to the VP of HR Technology & Innovation and leading Hilton's global HR Technology Product organization. Oversees strategy, delivery and continuous evolution of HCM platforms; owns product roadmaps, governance, releases, modernization and strategic vendor partnerships across Core HR, Recruiting, Learning and Talent; builds trusted relationships with senior HR and business leaders; and leads the product-management organization. Requires roughly 10 years in HR technology or related enterprise functions and 7 years leading people, with up to 15% travel.
jobs.fitLane: HR Technology Product Strategy / Employee Experience
jobs.summary: Clean progression from HRIS leadership into global product strategy, roadmap ownership and HR technology innovation.
jobs.source: Hilton posting via current public listing

jobs.title: Workforce Dimensions Transformation Senior Manager
jobs.salary: $180,200 - $355,100 base, plus possible discretionary annual incentive
jobs.jobDescription: Deloitte Human Capital consulting role helping organizations redesign work, workforce and operating models as AI, automation and digital transformation change enterprise value creation. Leads cross-functional teams developing workforce and organization strategies; aligns human capability, machine capacity and business goals; advises on workforce strategy, work design, operating models, organization effectiveness, skills, workforce analytics and AI impacts; structures complex client problems; develops executive recommendations; supports leadership alignment, business development, solution development and thought leadership. Requires 8+ years relevant experience, project/team leadership, business-development support and AI/digital transformation exposure. Recruiting is scheduled to close September 26, 2026 and travel is approximately 50%.
jobs.fitLane: Workforce Strategy / AI Transformation / Executive Advisory
jobs.summary: Strong workforce-strategy and consulting stretch with major compensation upside; key tradeoffs are 50% travel and business-development expectations.
